concept.title: Children and young people
concept.shortdesc: Children, teenagers and young people defined by age band, including pupils, juniors and under-age groups, along with adults defined by a minimum age.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Services for adults, described with the word "adults" and a minimum age of around 16 to 18.
: Services open to anyone or any people above a minimum age, mostly 18 and over, worded as "aged", "anyone" or "people over".
: Services for children and young people as one broad group, usually with an age range from birth or primary age up to the late teens or 25, plus some professionals who work with them.
: Services aimed at schools, colleges and their pupils, whether primary, secondary or whole-school.
: Services for teenagers or teens, including some with a stated age range or a specific condition.
: Junior members or players, typically children in club, sports or activity settings.
: Services for people below an upper age limit, such as under 18s, under 16s or under 10s, sometimes needing adult supervision.
: Services for young people with a stated age range, usually early teens to about 18 or 19.
